name: ecocheck
description: GHG inventory (ISO 14064-1, Vietnam Decree 06/2022), product carbon footprints (ISO 14067 LCA) and EU CBAM for manufacturers and exporters: three expert skills plus the EcoCheck connector to record activity data, compute emissions, product footprints and CBAM embedded emissions in your EcoCheck account.

interface.longDescription:
EcoCheck is a greenhouse-gas (GHG) inventory and EU CBAM platform used by manufacturers, exporters and their consultants in Vietnam. With EcoCheck in ChatGPT you can do your carbon work by just asking, in English or Vietnamese:

- Record monthly activity data (electricity, fuels, refrigerants, purchased goods) for each facility; EcoCheck picks the right emission factor and unit and calculates tCO2e.
- Get emissions by scope, ISO 14064-1 category, gas, source and month, find the largest sources, and track reduction targets.
- Check whether a product's CN code is covered by the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, look up EU default values, and compute actual specific embedded emissions (SEE) for steel, aluminium, cement and fertiliser installations.
- Calculate product carbon footprints (ISO 14067, cradle-to-gate or cradle-to-grave) from ready templates or your own processes and inputs, see the main contributors and uncertainty, and export the ISO 14067 report, a draft EPD or a PACT footprint for customers.
- Export Word inventory reports (ISO 14064-1 or Vietnam Decree 06/2022 templates).

Three expert skills (EU CBAM, ISO 14064-1 inventory, ISO 14067 product carbon footprint) guide the assistant through the regulations and methods.

Everything is saved in the same EcoCheck inventory your team uses on the web. Sign-in uses OAuth: ChatGPT never sees your password. The workspace owner sets each member's AI level (view only, view and edit, full access), can turn AI off, and reviews an audit log of every action. Deletions always require explicit confirmation.
capabilities: Record activity data and calculate emissions
Emissions reports by scope, ISO 14064-1 category and source
EU CBAM scope, default values and embedded emissions
Product carbon footprints (ISO 14067) and EPD drafts
defaultPrompt: Show our 2026 emissions by scope and the largest source.
Record this month's electricity use for our plant.
Is CN 7208 39 00 covered by CBAM, and what is the default value?

positive.description: List workspaces and the AI access level
positive.prompt: List my EcoCheck workspaces and tell me my AI access level.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one workspace, "EcoCheck Demo (AI directory review)" (code 0yv6katgeyr), role OWNER; AI access enabled at level FULL (Full access); the connection can write.

positive.prompt: What are Demo Steel's 2026 emissions by scope, and which source is the largest?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports about 1,281.75 t CO2e for 2026: Scope 2 1,270.67 t and Scope 1 11.08 t; the largest source is grid electricity (S2.001 EVN Electricity, 1,270.67 t), then diesel for forklifts (11.08 t).

positive.description: Preview the emissions of activity data (nothing saved)
positive.prompt: Without saving anything, preview the emissions of 165,000 kWh of grid electricity for the Demo Steel rolling mill in December 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 108,768 kg (about 108.77 t) CO2e on S2.001 EVN Electricity (0.6592 kg CO2e per kWh) and says nothing was saved.

positive.prompt: Show the CBAM specific embedded emissions of our hot-rolled product CN 7208 39 00 and compare them with the EU default value.
positive.expected_behavior: For the Demo Steel Rolling Mill (12,000 t of CN 72083900): actual SEE 2.805 t CO2e/t (direct; indirect not counted for steel) vs EU default 2.35 t/t, 2.585 t/t with the 10% mark-up for Vietnam; the actual value is about 8.5% above the marked-up default.

positive.description: Product carbon footprint (ISO 14067) and its report
positive.prompt: What is the carbon footprint per tonne of our hot-rolled steel coil, what are its main contributors, and export the ISO 14067 footprint report as a Word file.
positive.expected_behavior: For "Hot-rolled steel coil (Demo Steel)", year 2026 (final result, cradle-to-gate, IPCC AR6): about 2,594.65 kg CO2e per tonne (about 2.59 t). Main contributors: purchased steel billets at the CBAM default value for Viet Nam (about 2,444.7 kg, roughly 94%), grid electricity (about 75.2 kg) and natural gas for the reheating furnace (about 68.5 kg). Returns the Word file EcoCheck-PCF-ISO14067-Hot-rolled-steel-coil-Demo-Steel-<date>.docx (about 32 KB).

publication.release_notes: 1.0.4: product carbon footprints (LCA / PCF, ISO 14067): a new expert skill and connector tools to build product models from templates or your own processes, set quantities, scenarios and co-products, calculate with uncertainty and sensitivity, and export the ISO 14067 report, draft EPD, ILCD, PACT footprint and the model (Excel, JSON-LD, SimaPro, EcoSpold2). The existing tools are unchanged.
